note: Each source is a 1536x1024 triptych — front | back | side, split by thin white rules — of the same sitter, top and backdrop as the loose-hair library. `style` is the id in src/content/loc-styles.ts; `look` numbers a second or third set for the same style (1 when omitted). `style: null` holds a sheet back. Assignments confirmed by the owner on 2026-10-19. The five starter-method and statement styles with no sheet (comb-coil, braided, interlocked, mohawk, crown) render placeholders until one is generated. On 2026-10-28 every sheet with non-black hair was held back and replaced by a black-hair version (the `(black)` sheets), so the lookbook shows one hair colour throughout. `framed: true` marks a sheet whose panels are already 4:5 portraits (the `(black)` sheets were framed from grids of a different shape): they are cut at the rules as they are, with no reframing. `omit` lists angles a sheet does not really have: the panel is a stand-in that is cut for framing and then not written, so that slot keeps its placeholder.
